issues.issue: Outstanding is defined to include all authenticated Certificates subject only to cancellation and replacement exceptions, while the definition of Certificateholder deems Certificates held by the Master Servicer, the Depositor or their affiliates 'not to be Outstanding' for consent purposes. The two definitions must be reconciled to know what is Outstanding on a vote.
The definition breaks off at 'the Overcollateralization Target Amount for such Distribution 34', without completing the clause. The comparison that fixes the release amount is textually incomplete.

After ten enumerated categories, clause (k) permits 'such other investments bearing interest or sold at a discount acceptable to each Rating Agency,' a catch-all not limited by the character of the listed items. Its breadth against the enumerated specifics is open to argument.

Clause (vii) excludes 'any other Person so designated by the Depositor based upon an Opinion of Counsel,' a residual category resting on the Depositor's designation rather than on any stated criterion. Whether a transferee is permitted can turn on a discretionary act not otherwise constrained.

Limb (B) adds 'the Premium Distribution Amount for any prior Distribution Date, plus interest thereon at the Late Payment Rate' without limiting it to the unpaid portion, so on its face every prior period's premium is added again each month. The definition is also keyed to the Late Payment Rate, which is defined by reference to undefined 'Insured Notes' and a 'Class A Note Insurer.'

Prepayment Interest Excess is defined only as to AHM Mortgage Loans, yet the closing sentence disposes of 'All Prepayment Interest Excess' and the Interest Remittance Amount definition excludes Prepayment Interest Excess for the Mortgage Loans generally. Whether excess interest on non-AHM loans belongs to the Trust or the Servicer is unresolved between them.

The definition twice turns on whether a loan has become a 'Liquidated Loan,' a term the Agreement does not define; the defined term is 'Liquidated Mortgage Loan.' When a loan's Principal Balance drops to zero therefore rests on an undefined trigger.

The last clause directs that partial prepayments 'shall be applied in the Prepayment Period preceding the receipt thereof,' which places the application before the money arrives. The timing rule contradicts itself as written.

Clause (iii) counts 'the principal portion of all related Net Liquidation Proceeds,' a term the Agreement does not define; it defines 'Liquidation Proceeds' only. What is netted out before the proceeds reach the waterfall is left unstated.

The price includes 'any costs and damages incurred by the Trust in connection with any violation by such Mortgage Loan of any predatory or abusive lending law,' with no definition of the covered laws, of 'damages,' or of who determines them. That component of the Purchase Price has no ascertainable measure.

'Qualified Mortgage Insurer' requires only Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac approval, while the separately defined 'Qualified Insurer' imposes licensing and an 'AA' claims-paying rating for what is functionally the same insurer. Which standard governs a given Primary Insurance Policy depends on which term the operative provision uses.

The second sentence, covering a Deficient Valuation, is a fragment: it states 'the difference between the principal balance ... and the principal balance as reduced' without saying that this difference is a Realized Loss or when it is taken. The grammatical gap leaves the treatment of Deficient Valuations uncertain.

The definition covers Delay Certificates, Physical Certificates and No Delay Certificates 'held in Book-Entry Form,' leaving no Record Date for a No Delay Certificate that is not held in book-entry form. Definitive Certificates of those classes fall through the gap.

The provision says the term 'may refer to a portion of the Relevant Servicing Criteria applicable to such parties' without saying which portion or who decides. What criteria a Servicing Function Participant must assess is left open.

The definition extends beyond the cited Code sections and regulations to 'related provisions' and 'provisions of applicable state laws,' neither of which is identified. The body of law the Agreement requires be complied with is left unbounded.

'Residual Interests' is defined as 'specified in the Preliminary Statement,' but the Preliminary Statement designates the LT-R, MT1-R, MT2-R and Class R-IV interests without ever using that collective term. The referent of the definition is absent from the place it points to.

A Responsible Officer is any listed officer 'having direct responsibility for the administration of this Agreement and also to whom, with respect to a particular matter, such matter is referred because of such officer's knowledge,' so it is unclear whether both limbs must be satisfied. Whose knowledge is attributed to the Trustee or Trust Administrator turns on that reading.

If a later rule change makes certification 'in the reasonable judgment of the Master Servicer, materially more onerous,' the required certification becomes whatever the Master Servicer and Depositor agree after 'a negotiation in good faith.' The obligation is an agreement to agree with no fallback if they do not.

The Scheduled Payment gives effect to 'any related Debt Service Reduction,' a capitalized term the Agreement does not define. The adjustment to the scheduled payment therefore rests on an undefined concept.
